FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A01

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A01

Why it matters: group animals; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A01

Why it matters: group animals; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A01

Why it matters: group low-vis; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0079]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A02

Why it matters: group low-vis; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A02
Wipers light lamps, fresh rain slicks oil long, and gaps grow with stopping distance [A02].
Why it matters: group rain; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec08-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A02
Floating tires skid worst on soft pressure, bald tread, and speed [A02].
Why it matters: group hydroplane; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec08-R08 | anchor: A02
Wet brakes dry under gentle pedals while flooded roads always turn around [A02].
Why it matters: group water; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0080]

FACT_ID: sec08-R09 | anchor: A03
High beams dim at 500 feet coming and 300 going, and dusk-to-dawn lamps never park-only [A03].
Why it matters: group night-law; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec08-F11 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0081]

FACT_ID: sec08-R10 | anchor: A03
Night craft paces light reach, skims lines past stares, rests bright-dazzled eyes, and hugs right for one-eyed comers [A03].
Why it matters: group night-craft; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec08-F12 [A03].
